notes.text:
This update for go1.26-openssl fixes the following issues

- Update to version go1.26.5 (bsc#1255111).
- CVE-2026-39822: os: Root escape via symlink plus trailing slash (bsc#1271014).
- CVE-2026-42505: crypto/tls: omit PSK in ECH outer client hello (bsc#1271015).

notes.text: On Unix systems, opening a file in an os.Root improperly follows symlinks to locations outside of the Root when the final path component of the a path is a symbolic link and the path ends in /. For example, 'root.Open("symlink/")' will open "symlink" even when "symlink" is a symbolic link pointing outside of the root.
